captions.detailed: A 3D model of a gravel bicycle crankset featuring a wide, cylindrical bottom-bracket shell in a dark gray finish. Two matching, sleek black crank arms extend in opposite directions from a common spindle, with a large, 40T oval chainring mounted on the right-side spider. At the end of each crank arm, a composite clip-in pedal is attached, colored in contrasting gray and black. Both the spindle and the pedals are articulated on revolute axles to allow realistic rotation.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a gravel one-by crankset in CadQuery. The assembly should include a wide, hollow bottom-bracket shell, two matching hollow-forged crank arms connected by a common spindle, a 40T oval chainring on the right arm, and composite clip-in pedals. Define revolute joints for both the main spindle rotation relative to the shell and the individual pedal rotations relative to the crank arms.
captions.factory: Construct a bottom-bracket shell using a Cylinder primitive. Model the spindle and crank arms using swept profiles or combined Cylinder/Box primitives, positioning them at 180-degree offsets on either side of the shell. Create the oval chainring by extruding an ellipse with subtracted patterns to form the teeth and spider spokes. Define the pedals using a combination of Box and Cylinder primitives, and then establish continuous or revolute articulations for the spindle-to-shell connection and the pedal-to-crank-arm interfaces.
